title: Flick’s bold decision in Barcelona’s defeat to PSG sends a message about La Masia
tweet: Flick handed four 19‑year‑olds a Champions League start at PSG, a move unmatched by any other club that night. It shows he is ready to expose La Masia talent to top European pressure; as things stand, that could accelerate their integration. Whether the experiment will pay dividends remains to be seen.

title: Barcelona’s clever response to PSG’s kick-off tactic showcases impressive tactical awareness
tweet: Barcelona’s right‑back Espart anticipated PSG’s deep throw‑in before the ball left the pitch, catching the press off‑balance and feeding a quick pass to Cubarsi that bypassed the high press. The move shows a rehearsed team response, signalling that the Catalans will be harder to catch in future kick‑offs. As things stand, PSG may need to rethink that strategy.
